comment_regular: Verified (Oblivion): shared by all four 1x/2x texture-effect pass handlers used from ShadowLight, Skin, and Hair shader setup. Reads TextureEffectData from shaderProperty+0xE0, copies current fill/edge RGBA into ShadowLight shader-map backing, copies U/V offsets and edge exponent, writes the second fVars component as 1.0, then updates separate per-geometry property-state constants.
